Horses were frequently utilized in delivery of letters and messages. In the 19th century, a mail express system that used horses serviced a large area of the United States. Pigeons may be seen as a problem by many people today. However, in ancient Greece, they were used to mail people the results of the Olympics between cities. They were ideally suited to this job because they can go without water for quite a while. Fortunately, we’ve developed faster and more reliable delivery systems, but we should not ignore the important roles these animals played in the past.
